news.title: Palmer on playing free alongside Rogers
news.title_zh: 帕尔默谈与罗杰斯一起自由打球
news.body_en: Cole Palmer has revealed the conversations he had over the summer with Xabi Alonso and Morgan Rogers that helped him feel ready to produce his best on the pitch at Chelsea this season. Our No10 found it difficult to match the brilliant form of his previous two campaigns with the Blues last season, when his efforts were hindered by injury. However, joined in the line-up by old friend and new team-mate Rogers, under the guidance of manager Alonso, he has made a strong start to the 2026/27 Premier League. That was seen when he provided the assist for Joao Pedro to give us the lead just 31 seconds into our league opener, Rogers also getting on the score sheet before Palmer netted the winner himself, in a 3-2 victory over Fulham. ‘I just felt joy, really, and a bit of disbelief, because I didn't think we were going to score that quick,’ admitted Palmer. That win at Craven Cottage was the first glimpse of former Manchester City academy team-mates Palmer and Rogers in competitive action together for Chelsea, combining to provide the creative spark. ‘I think we're two different players,’ Cole added, when asked about that combination with Morgan. ‘He's more physical, more powerful and stuff, and I'm more technical and whatnot. ‘I just told him [when he joined] that he'll make a big difference. We're signing other players as well, so we're going to have a good team and we can do something good.’ As well as new team-mates, Palmer is playing under a new manager, following Alonso’s arrival in the dugout over the summer, and shared the main message he received from the Spaniard. ‘He just said to be free, because he knows what I can do when I feel good and I feel like I can go wherever on the pitch and find areas where I can cause damage. That's what he's told me.’ All of that leaves Palmer confident he can be back at his very best in 2026/27, although he revealed it is the mental impact of playing free of injury which he believes will make the biggest difference. ‘There were many things last season. Mainly just injury, though. It's just like, because you've been injured and then you're going out thinking, “oh, can I do certain things?”, kind of overthinking things. ‘It’s like, you're not doing things that you used to be able to do because previously it would hurt if you did it and whatnot. But I'm over that now.’ The evidence of that is clear on the pitch, after Palmer helped us open the new season with a league win over Fulham before booking our place in the Carabao Cup third round by beating Luton Town on Thursday evening. Next up, Palmer and Rogers will be hoping to combine to great effect again in our first home Premier League game of 2026/27, when we host Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge on Sunday.
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默透露了他今年夏天与哈维·阿隆索和摩根·罗杰斯的对话，这些对话帮助他做好了本赛季在切尔西球场上发挥最佳表现的准备。我们的10号球员发现很难与上赛季他在蓝军前两场比赛中的出色表现相媲美，当时他的努力受到了伤病的阻碍。不过，在老友新队友罗杰斯的加盟下，在主帅阿隆索的带领下，他在2026/27赛季的英超联赛中取得了强势开局。联赛揭幕战开场仅 31 秒，他就为若昂·佩德罗送出助攻，让我们取得领先，罗杰斯也取得进球，随后帕尔默攻入制胜球，帮助球队 3-2 战胜富勒姆。 “我只是感到高兴，真的，还有点难以置信，因为我认为我们不会这么快得分，”帕尔默承认。这场在克雷文小屋的胜利是前曼城青训队友帕尔默和罗杰斯第一次为切尔西在竞技比赛中展现出创造力的火花。当被问及与摩根的组合时，科尔补充道：“我认为我们是两个不同的球员。” “他的身体素质更强，力量更大等等，而我的技术更强等等。 “我只是告诉他（当他加入时）他会带来很大的改变。我们还将签下其他球员，所以我们将拥有一支优秀的球队，我们可以做一些好事。”除了新队友之外，帕尔默在阿隆索夏天来到教练席后，也在新教练的带领下踢球，并分享了他从西班牙人那里收到的主要信息。 “他只是说要自由，因为他知道当我感觉良好时我能做什么，我觉得我可以去球场上的任何地方，找到我可以造成伤害的区域。这就是他告诉我的。”所有这些都让帕尔默相信他可以在 2026/27 赛季恢复到最佳状态，尽管他透露，无伤比赛对精神上的影响，他认为这将带来最大的改变。 “上赛季发生了很多事情。不过主要只是受伤。就像，因为你受伤了，然后你出去想，“哦，我可以做某些事情吗？”，有点想太多了。 ‘这就像，你不再做以前能做的事情，因为以前如果你这样做就会受伤等等。但我现在已经克服了这一点。”在帕尔默帮助我们在联赛中战胜富勒姆开启新赛季之后，周四晚上击败卢顿镇，我们获得了卡拉宝杯第三轮的席位，这在球场上得到了明显的体现。接下来，帕尔默和罗杰斯希望在我们 2026/27 年首场英超主场比赛中再次联手，发挥出色的效果，届时我们将在斯坦福桥迎战布莱顿。

news.body_en: Chelsea are at home in the Premier League for the first time in 2026/27 on Sunday, with Brighton & Hove Albion the visitors to west London, and we have all the facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. Chelsea’s most recent win over the Seagulls came at Stamford Bridge in September 2024, when Cole Palmer scored a 10-minute first-half hat-trick — and four goals in total — to inspire a 4-2 victory.	  In the corresponding fixture at Stamford Bridge last September, two stoppage-time goals by Danny Welbeck and Maxim De Cuyper secured a 3-1 win for Brighton after Enzo Fernandez opened the scoring in the first half. Trevoh Chalobah was sent off after 53 minutes for denying an obvious goal scoring opportunity when we were winning 1-0.Chelsea are looking to prevent Brighton winning four consecutive Premier League games and five in all competitions against us for the first time.The Seagulls have scored three goals in each of their last three Premier League matches against Chelsea. Our summer signing Welbeck scored three of them. Xabi Alonso is the first Chelsea manager since Antonio Conte in 2016 to win his opening two competitive matches. Morgan Rogers against Fulham and Danny Welbeck against Luton became the 92nd and 93rd players to score on their Chelsea debut, and the first since Axel Disasi against Liverpool in August 2023. Chelsea have won 20 of our previous 34 opening home games of a Premier League season, drawing 10 and losing four. The Blues have won our first home league game of the season once in the past seven campaigns (four draws, two defeats), beating Crystal Palace 3-0 in 2021/22. Chelsea (120.1km) and Fulham (121.1km) covered more ground than any other Premier League teams on matchweek one. Chelsea have conceded in each of our last 17 Premier League matches, our longest league run without a clean sheet since a 17-game sequence in the old First Division, between March and August 1991. We last went longer without a league clean sheet in August 1961 (31 games).  Our last Premier League clean sheet was against Brentford at Stamford Bridge on 17 January. Joao Pedro has more goals and assists (13) than any other Premier League forward since the start of 2026. Cole Palmer won possession more times than any other player on the opening weekend of the Premier League season (seven). Palmer and Rogers created four chances for one another against Fulham, the most of any duo in the opening round of Premier League matches. If selected, Welbeck will become the first player ever to make a Premier League appearance for each of Arsenal, Chelsea and Manchester United. Welbeck leads the scoring in Premier League meetings between Chelsea and Brighton with six goals, one ahead of Palmer. Palmer needs two goals to reach 50 league goals for Chelsea. He will become the 28th player to reach the milestone for the club and the ninth in the Premier League era. In beating Aston Villa on Sunday, Brighton were the fastest team ever to go 4-0 up in a Premier League opener, reaching that score after 31 minutes. They had 73 per cent possession and 21 shots, six on target, while preventing Aston Villa from registering a shot on target in a Premier League match for the first time since 2022. Brighton are seeking their first away Premier League win since beating Burnley on 11 April, having drawn one and lost two away games since. The Seagulls had the 14th best away record in the competition last season with 20 points from their 19 matches. Brighton have won only three of their past 21 Premier League games in London, drawing eight and losing 10, and have conceded exactly twice in four of their last five matches in the capital. Goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen was the only Brighton player to play every minute of their Premier League games last term. Welbeck and Joao Pedro have either scored or assisted seven of Brighton’s last 13 Premier League goals against Chelsea (54 per cent) - Welbeck with three goals and two assists, Joao Pedro with one of each. news.title: Xabi Alonso explains how 'great influence' Danny Welbeck raises standards
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释“巨大影响力”丹尼·维尔贝克如何提高标准
news.body_en: Danny Welbeck has a history of scoring in fixtures between Chelsea and Brighton & Hove Albion. Thankfully, when the two sides meet tomorrow at Stamford Bridge, he will be trying to do so for the Blues. Before moving to the Bridge this summer, Welbeck spent six years with the Seagulls and became a thorn in the Blues' side.  He netted six goals and claimed two assists for Brighton in nine Premier League meetings with Chelsea, the most recent of which came in April. Welbeck displayed his goal-scoring instincts in a Chelsea shirt for the first time on Thursday. The 35-year-old was handed his debut in our Carabao Cup second-round tie against Luton Town, and he opened the scoring with a well-taken header. Whether Welbeck features in tomorrow's contest in west London is a decision for Blues manager Xabi Alonso. The Spaniard knows the qualities the striker provides – and is pleased Welbeck will not be lining up for Brighton on this occasion. 'I am aware [of his record in the fixture] and I am happy he is with us!' joked Alonso in his pre-match press conference. 'He has many qualities. As a player, you see how intelligent he is, and he links well. Out of the box, he is able to combine, and in the box he is very intelligent to be in the right place. We saw that [against Luton]. 'On a daily basis, he is a great influence for the rest of the players. He trains really hard and is raising all the standards in training. This is something we think is important.' While Welbeck and fellow summer arrival Jordan Henderson have brought a wealth of experience to the Blues squad, Alonso has been keen to stress the influence of several other players within the first-team group. 'They [Henderson and Welbeck] help but it’s not just them,' said Alonso. 'Reece [James], Maxence [Lacroix], Morgan [Rogers] as well. Even if they are younger, they have a good impact. 'That was a very important decision in the squad planning - that we were bringing players who add not just on the field, but are ready to compete and who don’t need much time to make an impact. We are happy with that.'
news.body_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克有在切尔西和布莱顿之间的比赛中进球的历史。值得庆幸的是，当双方明天在斯坦福桥相遇时，他将努力为蓝军做到这一点。在今年夏天转会到蓝桥之前，维尔贝克在海鸥队效力了六年，并成为蓝军的眼中钉。  他在布莱顿对阵切尔西的九场英超比赛中攻入六球并贡献两次助攻，最近一次是在四月份。周四，维尔贝克首次身披切尔西球衣展现了他的进球本能。这位35岁的球员在卡拉宝杯第二轮对阵卢顿镇的比赛中首次亮相，他以一记漂亮的头球首开纪录。维尔贝克是否参加明天在伦敦西部举行的比赛将由蓝军主帅哈维·阿隆索决定。西班牙人知道这名前锋的能力，并且很高兴维尔贝克这次不会为布莱顿效力。 “我知道[他在比赛中的记录]，我很高兴他和我们在一起！”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上开玩笑说。 “他有很多品质。作为一名球员，你会看到他是多么聪明，而且他的联系也很好。在禁区外，他能够进行组合，在禁区内他也非常聪明，能够处于正确的位置。我们在（对阵卢顿的比赛中）看到了这一点。 “在日常生活中，他对其他球员都有很大的影响。他训练非常刻苦，并且正在提高训练中的所有标准。我们认为这很重要。虽然维尔贝克和夏季新援乔丹·亨德森为蓝军带来了丰富的经验，但阿隆索一直热衷于强调一线队其他几名球员的影响力。 “他们（亨德森和维尔贝克）提供了帮助，但不仅仅是他们，”阿隆索说。里斯[詹姆斯]、马克森斯[拉克鲁瓦]、摩根[罗杰斯]也是如此。即使他们年纪还小，但他们的影响力还是不错的。 “这是球队规划中一个非常重要的决定——我们引进的球员不仅在场上，而且已经准备好参加比赛，而且不需要太多时间就能产生影响。我们对此感到高兴。

news.title: Summer transfers 2026: All the Chelsea ins, outs and new contracts so far
news.title_zh: 2026 年夏季转会：迄今为止切尔西的所有进场、出局和新合同
news.body_en: With the 2026 summer transfer window now open, we keep you updated with all the deals done so far this summer... Versatile midfielder Barco arrived from Strasbourg, signing a contract until 2033. He has previous experience of English football with Brighton. The 29-year-old Spaniard joined Chelsea early in August following four seasons with Rayo Vallecano. The experienced England international joined the Blues in August after leaving Brentford, agreeing a two-year deal at Stamford Bridge. Lacroix made the short journey from Crystal Palace to Chelsea towards the end of July, fresh from his involvement for France at the 2026 World Cup. Lacroix's deal lasts until 2032. The Italian international became our first signing of the summer when he joined on a permanent deal from Atalanta at the start of July. Palestra signed a contract through to 2033. The winger's move to Chelsea was first confirmed in March 2025, before officially completing his move from Sporting Lisbon this summer. The Portuguese teenager signed a contract until 2034. England international Morgan Rogers signed from Aston Villa in July 2026, penning a contract until 2033. He has played 22 times for the Three Lions, including at this summer's World Cup, and established himself as one of the top attacking talents in the Premier League. Dastan Satpayev completed a transfer to Chelsea after his 18th birthday, having been a part of our pre-season tour in Australia and Asia. He subsequently joined Burnley on loan. Joining from Brighton and Hove Albion, where he had impressed in recent seasons, striker Welbeck became our fifth signing of the summer. His contract runs to 2028. 18-year-old Bettoni joined from Wigan Athletic on a contract until 2030. The attacking midfielder featured 27 times for the Latics last season, scoring four goals. Osborne, 18, joined from Hearts in Scotland and put pen to paper on a contract with the Blues until 2030. Toby Bell signed his first professional contract. The goalkeeper made his Under-18 debut in November 2024 and has represented England throughout his development pathway. The young winger commited his long-term future to Chelsea by signing a new contract until 2032, shortly before agreeing a loan switch to swap London for Lisbon in the 2026/27 season with a spell at Sporting. Academy attacker Sol Gordon signed a new contract until 2029. Having joined Chelsea's development centre at Under-8 level, Gordon has progressed through the Academy ranks to become a regular for our Under-18s and has also featured for the Blues' Under-21s. Academy striker Jashayde Greenwood signed his first professional contract with the club following his 17th birthday and after a successful maiden campaign at Chelsea. Harrison, an Academy midfielder who established himself as a regular for our Under-21s last season as we lifted the Premier League 2 title, signed a new contract until 2029. He later joined Wimbledon on loan. Our midfielder signed his first professional contract with the Blues following his 17th birthday. He has been with our Academy since Under-8s level. Academy defender Osagie signed a new contract keeping him at the club until 2029. He established himself as an important member of our Under-21 side last season. Ahead of the campaign starting, Joao Pedro signed a new contract with Chelsea until 2034. The Brazilian netted 20 goals in his debut season at the Bridge and was voted our Player of the Year. Before joining Dulwich Hamlet on loan, Academy goalkeeper Sands signed a new three-year contract. After captaining Chelsea Under-18s to victory in the Under-18 Premier League national final in 2026, the centre-back signed his first professional contract with the Blues. The 19-year-old Academy player embarked on his first loan in August 2026, joining Ligue 1 side Strasbourg for the forthcoming campaign. The defender, who has played 71 times for the Blues, joined Napoli on loan for the season. Disasi has joined fellow Premier League side Crystal Palace for this season, having spent the second half of last term with West Ham United. The Argentina international joined Aston Villa on loan for 2026/27 having scored eight goals in 43 appearances in his first season at Stamford Bridge. Academy midfielder Harrison signed for League One side AFC Wimbledon for the season, embarking on his maiden loan away from the Bridge. The goalkeeper has moved to Strasbourg on loan for the season. The 17-year-old winger departed on his maiden loan spell in the senior game, signing for Portsmouth ahead of the Championship season starting. Young goalkeeper Max Merrick embarked on his third loan away from the Bridge by joining Hartlepool United of the National League for the season. He has been in our first team matchday squad on 11 occasions in recent years. Chelsea Academy defender Murray-Campbell, who made his senior Blues debut against Shamrock Rovers in the 2024/25 UEFA Conference League, will spend the coming season gaining further experience of men's football with KV Kortrijk in the Belgian first division. The defender has joined Notts County of League One for the 2026/27 campaign, following his loan spell with Swansea City last term. The young goalkeeper signed a new contract until 2029 and joined non-league side Dulwich Hamlet on a youth loan. The defender will spend this season in Spain, after joining Real Sociedad on loan. He has made seven appearances for Chelsea since arriving from Strasbourg. After completing his transfer to Chelsea, the Kazakh attacker moved to Burnley on loan for the season. Walsh, who played four games for our senior team in 2025 including as a 16-year-old, will spend the season on loan at Wigan Athletic in League One this season. The American has made a season-long loan move to Championship side Preston North End, having previously represented Watford on loan in that division. Wilson embarked on his first loan in senior football in July 2026, joining newly-promoted League Two side Rochdale for the forthcoming campaign. The winger left for Ipswich Town after a season playing for our Academy sides. The teenager came through the ranks at the Chelsea Academy from Under-8s level and featured for our Under-18s in pre-season. He has now joined Reading. Chalobah completed a permanent transfer to Como in August, bringing his time as a Chelsea player to an end after nearly two decades with the Blues. He won four trophies, having established himself in our first team ahead of the 2021/22 campaign. The Spaniard left for Real Madrid after four successful seasons at Stamford Bridge during which he won the Club World Cup and the UEFA Conference League, as well as helping Spain triumph in the 2024 Euros. Delap departed for Nottingham Forest after 14 months with Chelsea. The striker played 41 times for the Blues, including six of our seven games during last summer's victorious FIFA Club World Cup campaign. The winger made his loan move to Everton permanent this summer, departing Chelsea after progressing through our Academy and making 37 appearances for the senior team. The versatile defender spent 13 years in our Academy having joined as an Under-8. He was released at the end of the 2025/26 season, which he spent on loan at AFC Wimbledon. The Senegal striker completed a permanent transfer to fellow Premier League side Aston Villa. Jackson was part of the Chelsea squads that won the Conference League and Club World Cup, scoring against Real Betis in the final of the former. The attacking midfielder made a permanent move to France with Ligue 1 club Strasbourg, after spending last season on loan with Cardiff City, where he helped them earn promotion to the Championship. The Academy forward completed a permanent move to Championship side West Bromwich Albion after impressing on loan at Peterborough last season. Morgan had returned to Chelsea, where he spent time in our Academy as a youngster, in February 2023. Olise also moved on after a decade with the club. Signed by Chelsea as an Under-9, Olise featured throughout the age groups in our Academy and was named in the first-team squad for our UEFA Conference League trip to Astana during the 2024/25 season. Runham sealed a permanent switch to Ipswich Town having spent the second half of last season on loan with the Tractor Boys. The move brought the attacking midfielder's long association with Chelsea to an end. Rak-Sakyi made four first-team appearances, all in our triumphant Conference League campaign, having developed through our Academy. The midfield was released at the expiry of his contract. The midfielder made 47 appearances for Chelsea and became a full Brazil international during his three years as a Blue. He has now completed a permanent transfer to Manchester United. The Finnish youth international's six-year spell at Chelsea ended this summer. He made his first-team debut in an FA Cup win over Leeds in March 2024, and also featured in the Premier League when he came on in a home victory against Tottenham. The young defender spent the second half of last season on loan at Brentford, featuring mainly for their reserve side, and made that switch permanent over the summer.

月初从亚特兰大永久签约，成为我们今年夏天的第一笔签约。帕莱斯特拉签订的合同到2033年为止。这位边锋于2025年3月首次确认转会至切尔西，然后在今年夏天正式完成从里斯本竞技的转会。这位葡萄牙少年的合同到2034年为止。英格兰国脚摩根·罗杰斯于2026年7月从阿斯顿维拉签约，合同到2033年为止。他已经为三狮军团出场22次，包括今年夏天的世界杯，并确立了自己作为英超顶级进攻天才之一的地位。达斯坦·萨帕耶夫 (Dastan Satpayev) 在 18 岁生日后完成转会至切尔西，参加了我们在澳大利亚和亚洲的季前赛之旅。随后他被租借加盟伯恩利。前锋维尔贝克从近几个赛季给人留下深刻印象的布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩加盟，成为我们今年夏天的第五名签约球员。他的合同有效期至2028年。18岁的贝托尼从维冈竞技加盟，合同期至2030年。这位攻击型中场上赛季为维冈竞技出场27次，打进4球。 18 岁的奥斯本从苏格兰红心队加盟，并与蓝军签订了一份至 2030 年的合同。托比·贝尔签署了他的第一份职业合同。这位门将于 2024 年 11 月首次代表 18 岁以下国家队出场，并在他的整个发展道路上代表英格兰队出场。这位年轻的边锋将自己的长期未来交给了切尔西，签下了一份到2032年的新合同，不久之后他同意租借转会，在2026/27赛季从伦敦转会到里斯本，并在里斯本竞技效力了一段时间。青训前锋索尔·戈登签署了一份新合同，直至 2029 年。在加入切尔西 8 岁以下级别的发展中心后，戈登已经在青训营中不断晋升，成为我们 18 岁以下青年队的主力球员，并且还为蓝军 21 岁以下青年队效力。青训前锋贾沙伊德·格林伍德在 17 岁生日后以及在切尔西取得成功的处女赛季后与俱乐部签订了第一份职业合同。哈里森是一名青训营中场球员，上赛季我们举起了英超二级联赛冠军，他成为了我们 21 岁以下青年队的主力球员，他签下了一份新合同至 2029 年。后来他租借加盟温布尔登。我们的中场球员在 17 岁生日后与蓝军签订了第一份职业合同。他从 U-18 队在 2026 年 U-18 英超联赛全国决赛中获胜后，这位中后卫与蓝军签订了他的第一份职业合同。这位19岁的青训球员于2026年8月开始了他的第一次租借，加盟法甲球队斯特拉斯堡参加即将到来的赛季。这名后卫为蓝军出场71次，本赛季租借加盟那不勒斯。迪萨西本赛季加盟英超球队水晶宫，上赛季后半段他在西汉姆联队效力。这位阿根廷国脚在2026/27赛季租借加盟阿斯顿维拉，他在斯坦福桥的第一个赛季出场43次打进8球。青训中场球员哈里森本赛季与甲级联赛球队亚足联温布尔登签约，开始了他在蓝桥的首次租借。这名门将本赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡。 这位17岁的边锋在成年队比赛中首次租借，在英冠赛季开始前加盟朴茨茅斯。年轻门将马克斯·梅里克开始了他第三次租借离开蓝桥，加盟国家联赛的哈特尔普尔联队本赛季。近年来，他曾 11 次入选我们一线队的比赛阵容。切尔西学院后卫穆雷-坎贝尔在 2024/25 赛季欧洲足联会议联赛中对阵沙姆洛克流浪者队的比赛中完成了他的蓝军首秀，他将在下个赛季在比利时甲级联赛的 KV Kortrijk 队中获得更多的男子足球经验。这名后卫上赛季被租借到斯旺西城，随后加盟了英甲联赛的诺茨郡队参加2026/27赛季的比赛。这位年轻门将续约至2029年，并以青年租借的方式加盟非联赛球队德威哈姆雷特。这名后卫在租借加盟皇家社会后将在西班牙度过本赛季。自从从斯特拉斯堡来到切尔西以来，他已经为切尔西出场七次。在完成转会至切尔西后，这位哈萨克斯坦前锋被租借至伯恩利一个赛季。沃尔什在 2025 年为我们的成年队打了四场比赛，其中包括 16 岁时的比赛，本赛季他将被租借到英甲联赛的维冈竞技队度过整个赛季。美国人已经租借到英冠球队普雷斯顿北区一个赛季，此前他曾租借代表沃特福德效力该级别球队。威尔逊于 2026 年 7 月开始了他在成年足球队的第一次租借，加盟新晋级的乙级联赛球队罗奇代尔参加即将到来的赛季。这位边锋在为我们的青训队效力一个赛季后离开前往伊普斯维奇镇。这名少年是从切尔西青训学院 8 岁以下级别出身的，并在季前赛中代表我们 18 岁以下球队出场。他现在已经加入雷丁队。查洛巴于八月永久转会到科莫，结束了他在蓝军效力近二十年后的切尔西球员生涯。他赢得了四座奖杯，在 2021/22 赛季之前确立了自己在我们一线队的地位。这位西班牙人在斯坦福桥度过了四个成功的赛季后前往皇家马德里，期间他赢得了世俱杯和欧洲联盟联赛冠军，并帮助西班牙赢得了 2024 年欧洲杯。德拉普在切尔西效力 14 个月后前往诺丁汉森林。这位前锋为蓝军出场 41 次，其中包括去年夏天赢得国际足联俱乐部世界杯期间的七场比赛中的六场。这位边锋于今年夏天永久租借至埃弗顿，在完成青训并为成年队出场 37 次后离开切尔西。这位多才多艺的后卫在我们的青训营度过了 13 年，作为 8 岁以下球员加入。他在2025/26赛季结束后被释放，并被租借到亚足联温布尔登。这位塞内加尔前锋完成了永久转会至英超球队阿斯顿维拉。杰克逊是切尔西队赢得分区联赛和世俱杯冠军的一员，他在前者的决赛中对阵皇家贝蒂斯时进球。这位攻击型中场球员上赛季被租借到卡迪夫城并帮助他们升级到英冠，随后他永久转会至法国法甲俱乐部斯特拉斯堡。这位青训前锋上赛季租借到彼得伯勒队给人留下了深刻的印象，之后永久转会至英冠球队西布罗姆维奇队。 2023 年 2 月，摩根回到了切尔西，年轻时他曾在我们的青训营度过了一段时光。奥利斯在俱乐部效力十年后也离开了球队。奥利塞作为 9 岁以下球员被切尔西签下，在我们青训营的各个年龄段中都有出色表现，并入选了 2024/25 赛季前往阿斯塔纳的欧足联会议联赛的一线队阵容。鲁纳姆在上赛季后半段被租借到拖拉机男孩队后，永久转会到伊普斯维奇镇。此举结束了这位攻击型中场与切尔西的长期合作关系。拉克-萨基在我们青训学院的培养下，在我们凯旋的分区联赛中四次代表一线队出场。这名中场球员在合同到期后被释放。这位中场球员为切尔西出场 47 次，并在效力蓝军的三年里成为一名正式的巴西国脚。他现在已经完成了向曼联的永久转会。这位芬兰青年国脚在切尔西的六年任期于今年夏天结束。 2024年3月，他在足总杯战胜利兹联的比赛中完成一线队首秀，并在主场战胜托特纳姆热刺的英超联赛中出场。这位年轻的后卫上赛季后半段被租借到布伦特福德，主要为预备队效力，并在夏天永久转会。

news.title: Nicolas Jackson departs Chelsea on permanent transfer
news.title_zh: 尼古拉斯·杰克逊永久转会离开切尔西
news.body_en: Nicolas Jackson has completed a permanent transfer from Chelsea to Aston Villa. The Senegal international arrived at Stamford Bridge in June 2023 from Spanish club Villarreal. Jackson was part of the Chelsea squads that won the UEFA Conference League and FIFA Club World Cup trophies. He netted 13 goals during that campaign, including one in the Wroclaw showpiece against Real Betis. The 25-year-old featured for the Blues under Xabi Alonso in pre-season, but now heads to Villa Park and brings an end to his time at Stamford Bridge. We thank Nico for his efforts during his time at the club and wish him well for the future.
news.body_zh: 尼古拉斯·杰克逊已经完成从切尔西到阿斯顿维拉的永久转会。这位塞内加尔国脚于 2023 年 6 月从西班牙俱乐部比利亚雷亚尔抵达斯坦福桥。杰克逊是切尔西队赢得欧洲联盟联赛和国际足联俱乐部世界杯奖杯的一员。在那场比赛中，他打进了 13 个进球，其中包括在弗罗茨瓦夫对阵皇家贝蒂斯的比赛中打进的一球。这位25岁的球员在季前赛中代表哈维·阿隆索麾下的蓝军出场，但现在前往维拉公园，结束了他在斯坦福桥的时光。我们感谢尼科在俱乐部期间所做的努力，并祝愿他未来一切顺利。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek two
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第二周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are, and why Joao Pedro (£7.6) is Chelsea’s most popular player. Cole Palmer (£9.5m) looked back to his best and delivered a differential 13-point haul for his 14% ownership. The Englishman added a second-half goal to his assist in the first minute on his way to securing maximum bonus points. Palmer was involved in everything going forward, racking up five shots and three chances created. His performance against Fulham will encourage Fantasy managers - Cole returned 244 points in 29 starts during the 2023/24 season, especially with other premium assets blanking on the opening weekend. The Blues’ two summer signings, Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) and Maxence Lacroix (£6.0m), have put themselves firmly on Fantasy managers’ radars. The former continued where he left off in Chelsea’s final pre-season friendly against Real Sociedad by scoring one of three shots he had at Craven Cottage. Rogers’ goal was assisted by Lacroix, who topped off a superb defensive display with an impressive assist, showcasing his offensive threat. The Frenchman also returned defensive contribution points, something he made a habit of doing last season in a Crystal Palace shirt. Unsurprisingly, Joao Pedro (£7.6m) is the highest-owned Chelsea player in FPL. The Brazilian currently sits in 67% of teams, second among all players. Over 290,000 managers have transferred in the Brazilian ahead of Friday’s GW2 deadline, resulting in a price rise of £0.1m, following his 11-point haul against Fulham. Joao Pedro, who was the only forward to score more than nine points in GW1, picked up a goal, an assist and claimed a share of the bonus points. Last season, the Brazilian returned 177 Fantasy points thanks to 15 goals and nine assists, his best-ever season across all three metrics. The underlying data for Joao Pedro in 2025/26 was equally impressive. No Chelsea player managed more shots (73), big chances (26) or Expected Goals (14.96). JP will be keen to impress against his old club Brighton on Sunday. The Seagulls are in UEFA Conference League action on Thursday. In defence, Josh Acheampong (£4.5m) played the full 90 minutes and returned defensive contribution points. No Chelsea player racked up more DefCons than the Englishman’s tally of 15, thanks to five tackles, seven clearances, two blocks and one interception. Acheampong is attractively priced if he can keep his place with Wesley Fofana (£5.0m) returning from suspension. On the other side of the back-three, Levi Colwill (£5.0m) also featured. The Englishman scored against his former club Brighton at Stamford Bridge back in the 2023/24 season. Bruno Fernandes (£12.0m) is likely to be the most captained player this weekend for Manchester United’s home match against Ipswich Town. Despite a disappointing result in Gameweek 1, the Red Devils’ captain registered three shots and three chances created against Hull. With penalties and other set-pieces in his locker, Fernandes carries explosive potential for Gameweek 2. Elsewhere, Erling Haaland (£15.5m) will be looking to get off the mark against Crystal Palace on Friday night after blanking on the opening weekend. Last season’s Golden Boot winner racked up 239 points in 25/26 thanks to 27 goals, eight assists and 43 bonus points. The Norwegian’s underlying numbers were encouraging against Bournemouth, with a match-high five shots and a 0.74 xG tally.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是必备球员，谁是最具性价比的球员，以及为什么若奥·佩德罗（7.6英镑）是切尔西最受欢迎的球员。科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer，950 万英镑）回顾了自己的最佳状态，并以 14% 的所有权获得了 13 分的差价。这位英国人在下半场第一分钟的助攻中又进了一个球，从而获得了最大的积分。帕尔默参与了接下来的一切，完成了五次射门并创造了三个机会。他在对阵富勒姆的比赛中的表现将鼓舞幻想队主教练——科尔在2023/24赛季的29场首发中拿下244分，尤其是在首周末其他优质资产空白的情况下。蓝军夏季的两笔签约，摩根·罗杰斯（750万英镑）和马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦（600万英镑），已经牢牢地受到了幻想队经理的关注。前者在切尔西对阵皇家社会的最后一场季前友谊赛中继续他在克雷文小屋的三脚射门中的一脚。罗杰斯的进球得到了拉克鲁瓦的助攻，拉克鲁瓦以精彩的防守表现和令人印象深刻的助攻，展示了他的进攻威胁。法国人还回报了防守贡献分，这是他上赛季穿着水晶宫球衣时养成的习惯。不出所料，若昂·佩德罗（760 万英镑）是 FPL 中身价最高的切尔西球员。巴西人目前在球队中的出场率高达 67%，在所有球员中排名第二。在周五的第二届世界杯截止日期之前，已有超过 290,000 名巴西教练转会这名巴西人，在他对阵富勒姆的比赛中拿下 11 分后，他的身价上涨了 10 万英镑。若昂·佩德罗是第一届总决赛中唯一得分超过 9 分的前锋，他贡献了一个进球和一次助攻，并分享了奖励积分。上赛季，这位巴西人凭借 15 个进球和 9 次助攻，获得 177 分幻想积分，这是他在所有三项指标上表现最好的一个赛季。若奥·佩德罗在 2025/26 赛季的基础数据同样令人印象深刻。没有任何切尔西球员的射门次数（73）、绝佳机会（26）或预期进球（14.96）更多。 JP将渴望在周日对阵他的老东家布莱顿的比赛中给人留下深刻的印象。海鸥队将于周四参加欧洲足联会议联赛。在防守方面，乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong，450万英镑）打满了90分钟，并获得了防守贡献分。没有任何一位切尔西球员的防守次数能超过这位英国人的 15 次防守次数，这要归功于 5 次铲球、7 次解围、2 次拦网和 1 次拦截。如果阿奇姆蓬能够在韦斯利·福法纳（Wesley Fofana，500万英镑）停赛归来的情况下保住自己的位置，那么他的身价很有吸引力。在三后卫的另一边，利瓦伊·科尔威尔（Levi Colwill，500万英镑）也登场。 2023/24赛季，这位英国人在斯坦福桥对阵老东家布莱顿的比赛中进球。布鲁诺·费尔南德斯（1200万英镑）很可能成为本周末曼联主场对阵伊普斯维奇的比赛中担任队长次数最多的球员。尽管第一周比赛的结果令人失望，但红魔队长在对阵赫尔城的比赛中射门3次并创造了3次机会。费尔南德斯的储物柜里有点球和其他定位球，他在第二场比赛中具有爆炸性的潜力。在其他地方，埃尔林·哈兰德（1550万英镑）在首周末对阵水晶宫的比赛中表现不佳，他将寻求在周五晚上对阵水晶宫的比赛中取得好成绩。这位上赛季的金靴奖得主在 25/26 的比赛中凭借 27 粒进球、8 次助攻和 43 分奖励积分获得 239 分。挪威人在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中的基本数据令人鼓舞，有全场最高的 5 次射门和 0.74 的 xG 得分。

news.title: National League Cup report: Wycombe Wanderers Women 0-6 Chelsea Women's Under-18s
news.title_zh: 国家联赛杯报告：韦科姆流浪者女足 0-6 切尔西 18 岁以下女足
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s made a superb start to their senior Women’s National League Cup campaign with a commanding 6-0 victory away at Wycombe Wanderers Women Chelsea N'Drin opened the scoring from the penalty spot on the half-hour and the Blues then struck five times after the interval, as Tess Finn, N'Drin again, Carla Gardiner, Maisie Brickell and Rebekah Pierce also found the net. Leanne Champ's side created a host of chances and dealt impressively with the physicality of their senior opponents, combining sharp transition play with composed finishing while keeping a clean sheet. Chelsea were made to work for the opening goal by a physical Wycombe side, but our youngsters continued to create chances and our positive play down the right was rewarded after 30 minutes. Gabi Storey, Keira Johnson and Brickell combined before the latter drove into the penalty area. Brickell skipped beyond three Wycombe players and was eventually brought down, leaving the referee to point to the spot. N'Drin stepped up and converted with power and placement into the corner, giving Chelsea a deserved lead that we carried into the interval. The Blues resumed with real purpose and doubled the advantage two minutes into the second half. Storey and Johnson combined on the right, with the latter delivering a low cross into the area. N'Drin's first effort was blocked, but Jahyma Putman recovered possession and spun before finding Finn on the edge of the box. The midfielder drove forward and finished across goal. Chelsea's reaction to a Wycombe throw-in brought the third goal on 57 minutes. Brickell won the first contact high up the pitch and Johnson controlled the ball before turning and releasing N'Drin on the right side of the area. The forward spotted the goalkeeper advancing from her line and produced a composed chip to claim her second goal. Gardiner was introduced in place of N'Drin after 65 minutes and needed only one minute to make an impact. Patient build-up play was recycled to goalkeeper Freya Weeks, whose long diagonal pass cleared the Wycombe defence and found Putman. Her early cross was met first time by the arriving Gardiner to make it 4-0. Chelsea added a fifth on 81 minutes after reacting quickly to regain possession in the middle third. Gardiner found Pierce on the left and the substitute drove inside before playing through Wycombe's defensive line for Brickell, who supplied a composed finish. There was still time for one final goal in the second minute of stoppage time. Chelsea won the first and second balls from a long Wycombe goal-kick, allowing captain Belle Sullivan to combine with Finn in midfield. Finn passed into Pierce's forward run and the substitute advanced into space before sending a superb long-range finish dipping beneath the crossbar. The emphatic victory puts Chelsea at the top of Group D after the opening round of Women's National League Cup fixtures, with two group matches remaining. Chelsea return to Professional Game Academy South League action on Sunday 30 August, when Crystal Palace visit. Chelsea Women Under-18s (4-3-3): Freya Weeks; Elise Christian, Sophie Leach, Gabi Storey (Sadie Gregory 72’), Zoe Ciccardini; Belle Sullivan (c), Tess Finn, Keira Johnson; Jahyma Putman (Rebekah Pierce 72’), Chelsea N'Drin (Carla Gardiner 65’), Maisie BrickellUnused subs: Bella BartlettScorers: N'Drin 30 (pen), 57; Finn 47; Gardiner 66; Brickell 81; Pierce 90+2Manager: Leanne Champ
news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下女足在女子国家联赛杯成年组比赛中取得了出色的开局，客场以 6-0 大胜韦科姆流浪者队女足，切尔西·恩德林在半小时内通过点球破门，蓝军随后在中场休息后五次进球，苔丝·芬恩、恩德林再次进球，卡拉·加德纳、麦茜·布里克尔和丽贝卡·皮尔斯也进球。 Leanne Champ 的球队创造了很多机会，并以令人印象深刻的方式应对了高级对手的身体素质，将敏锐的转换进攻与沉着的射门相结合，同时保持不失球。威科姆队的体力让切尔西队首开纪录，但我们的年轻球员继续创造机会，我们在右路的积极表现在 30 分钟后得到了回报。加比·斯托雷、凯拉·约翰逊和布里克尔联手，后者带球进入禁区。布里克尔跳过了三名威科姆球员，最终被放倒，让裁判指向了现场。恩德林挺身而出，在角球中充满力量和位置，为切尔西赢得了当之无愧的领先优势，我们将其带入了中场休息。蓝军恢复了真正的目标，并在下半场两分钟后将优势扩大了一倍。斯托里和约翰逊在右路联手，后者低传到禁区。恩德林的第一次射门被挡出，但贾希玛·普特曼重新夺回控球权并旋转，然后发现禁区边缘的芬恩。中场球员向前推进并越过球门完成射门。第 57 分钟，切尔西队对韦科姆掷界外球的反应带来了第三个进球。布里克尔赢得了球场上的第一次接触，约翰逊控制了球，然后转身释放了禁区右侧的恩德林。这位前锋发现了守门员从她的防线上推进，并做出了一个冷静的射门，攻入了她的第二个进球。加德纳在 65 分钟后取代恩德林上场，只需要一分钟就产生了影响。守门员弗雷亚·威克斯（Freya Weeks）耐心地组织进攻，她的长对角传球突破了威科姆的防守，找到了普特曼。她的传中第一次被到达的加德纳接住，将比分改写为4-0。切尔西在第 81 分钟迅速反应，在中场重新夺回控球权后，再进第五球。加德纳在左侧找到皮尔斯，替补球员突破内线，然后突破韦科姆的防线，为布里克尔打进一记沉着的射门。伤停补时第二分钟，还有时间打进最后一球。切尔西通过韦科姆的长距离球门球赢得了第一个和第二个球，让队长贝尔·沙利文与芬恩在中场联手。芬恩传球给皮尔斯的前插，替补球员推进到空位，然后在横梁下方送出一记精彩的远射。这场大胜让切尔西在女子国家联赛杯首轮比赛后以 D 组榜首的身份晋级，目前还剩下两场小组赛。切尔西将于 8 月 30 日周日重返职业比赛学院南联赛，届时水晶宫将作客。切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 (4-3-3)：Freya Weeks； Elise Christian、Sophie Leach、Gabi Storey（Sadie Gregory 72’）、Zoe Ciccardini；贝尔·沙利文 (c)、泰丝·芬恩、凯拉·约翰逊； Jahyma Putman (Rebekah Pierce 72'), Chelsea N'Drin (Carla Gardiner 65'), Maisie Brickell未使用的替补：贝拉·巴特利特得分手：N'Drin 30（点球），57；芬兰人 47；加德纳66；布里克尔81； Pierce 90+2经理：Leanne Champ

news.title: Jorja Fox leaves Chelsea
news.title_zh: 乔贾·福克斯离开切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea can confirm defender Jorja Fox has today completed a permanent move to Ipswich Town. Fox joined the Chelsea Academy at the age of eight and made her senior debut for the Blues in a 4-0 away victory against Aston Villa in the 2020/21 campaign. Later that season, she made her first start in a 5-0 win over London City Lionesses. Her first professional contract with the club came in August 2021, on the day she turned 18. Loans to Charlton Athletic, Brighton and Hove Albion and Crystal Palace followed as she gained experience at senior level. Fox signed a contract extension with Chelsea in August 2024 and last season joined Newcastle United on a further loan. On the international stage, Fox represented England at every youth level during her time with the Blues. Everyone at Chelsea would like to wish Jorja every success in her future career.
news.body_zh: 切尔西确认后卫乔贾·福克斯今天已永久转会至伊普斯维奇。福克斯八岁时加入切尔西青训学院，并在2020/21赛季客场4-0战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛中首次代表蓝军出场。那个赛季晚些时候，她在 5-0 战胜伦敦城狮队的比赛中首次首发。她与俱乐部的第一份职业合同于 2021 年 8 月签订，这一天她年满 18 岁。随着她在高层积累了经验，她又被租借给查尔顿竞技队、布莱顿霍夫队和水晶宫队。福克斯于2024年8月与切尔西续约，上赛季进一步租借加盟纽卡斯尔联。在国际舞台上，福克斯在蓝军效力期间代表了英格兰各个青年级别的球员。切尔西的每个人都祝愿乔贾在未来的职业生涯中取得成功。

news.title: Important information on Stamford Bridge bag policy
news.title_zh: 有关斯坦福桥行李政策的重要信息
news.body_en: Ahead of Chelsea's first Premier League home match of the 2026/27 season, we would like to remind supporters of the bag policy in place at Stamford Bridge. The Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025, also known as ‘Martyn’s Law’, will come into effect in the UK in 2027. The legislation will require the club to demonstrate enhanced and robust security arrangements for everyone attending our home games. The bag policy is one of the measures we have in place for the safety and security of everyone attending our matches. To help maintain a safe environment and support quicker entry to Stamford Bridge, only bags no larger than A4 size are permitted. The maximum permitted dimensions are 30cm × 20cm × 10cm, approximately the size of a standard handbag. In anticipation of the requirements under Martyn’s Law, the bag policy will be strictly applied for all home matchdays at Stamford Bridge. Any bag that exceeds these dimensions will not be permitted into the stadium. The club strongly recommends that supporters avoid bringing bags to Stamford Bridge where possible. Supporters bringing a permitted bag should allow extra time for entry, as all bags are subject to search. While the club does not provide a bag storage facility at the stadium, options are available in the local area, including a matchday bag drop provided by Fulham Broadway Shopping Centre. You can find more information about this bag drop by clicking here. Any bag storage services in the local area are operated independently and are not affiliated with or controlled by the club. Exemptions to bag size restrictions will continue to be available for supporters who need to bring accessibility or medical equipment. More information on requesting a medical exemption can be found by clicking this link.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西 2026/27 赛季首场英超主场比赛之前，我们想提醒球迷注意斯坦福桥的行李政策。 《2025 年恐怖主义（场地保护）法案》（也称为“马丁法”）将于 2027 年在英国生效。该法案将要求俱乐部为观看主场比赛的每个人提供增强且稳健的安全安排。行李政策是我们为确保参加比赛的每个人的安全而采取的措施之一。为了帮助维护安全的环境并支持更快地进入斯坦福桥，仅允许携带不大于 A4 尺寸的行李。允许的最大尺寸为 30 厘米 × 20 厘米 × 10 厘米，大约是标准手提包的尺寸。考虑到马丁定律的要求，斯坦福桥的所有主场比赛日都将严格适用行李政策。任何超过这些尺寸的行李将不允许进入体育场。俱乐部强烈建议球迷们尽可能避免携带行李前往斯坦福桥。携带允许携带的行李的支持者应该留出额外的时间进入，因为所有行李都会受到搜查。虽然俱乐部在体育场内不提供行李寄存设施，但当地提供多种选择，包括富勒姆百老汇购物中心提供的比赛日行李托运服务。您可以点击此处找到有关此行李托运的更多信息。当地任何行李寄存服务均独立运营，不隶属于俱乐部或受俱乐部控制。需要携带无障碍设施或医疗设备的支持者将继续享受行李尺寸限制的豁免。单击此链接可以找到有关请求医疗豁免的更多信息。

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is hopeful Chelsea midfielder Moises Caicedo will be ready to face Brighton & Hove Albion on Sunday, and says Levi Colwill and Geovany Quenda are in contention to face the Seagulls. Our third game of the week comes in the Premier League, as we welcome Fabian Hurzeler's side to Stamford Bridge. It is an opportunity for the Blues to make it three wins from three matches at the start of the campaign. Our latest victory came on Thursday evening as we defeated Luton Town in the Carabao Cup second round. Alonso selected a strong side, with a Danny Welbeck header and an own goal from Hakeem Odoffin sealing our progression to the third round. Neither Colwill nor Quenda were involved against the Hatters. Yet Alonso stressed there was no reason for concern, with both players being managed through a busy week. He explained: ‘There were no issues, and the plan is that they are training [from Friday] and preparing for the game on Sunday. 'With Levi, after his injury last season, he is still in a period where he has to take the right steps, we don’t want to push him too much. We want to make sure [his body] doesn't get stressed and that he feels comfortable and well. It’s the same with Geo as well.’ Caicedo hasn't yet featured for the Blues this season due to what, ahead of our opening fixture, Alonso detailed as a setback suffered in training. However, the Blues boss is hopeful the Ecuadorian will train ahead of the visit of his former club and be available for selection come Sunday's game. Alonso said: ‘He is hopefully training [on Friday] and we are hopeful that he can be involved [against Brighton]. But we need to check. No decision has been made.’ One player expected to be in contention to return for the Blues on Sunday is Wesley Fofana, who served the second of his two-match suspension against Luton. Summer signing Jordan Henderson, meanwhile, may need more time, with Alonso confirming in his pre-match press conference that the Blues are waiting for him to be given the 'green light to play soon' following the injury he sustained during the World Cup.
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索希望切尔西中场球员莫伊塞斯·凯塞多能够做好周日对阵布莱顿的准备，并表示列维·科尔威尔和乔瓦尼·昆达正在争夺对阵海鸥队的比赛。我们本周的第三场比赛是英超联赛，我们欢迎法比安·胡尔泽勒的球队来到斯坦福桥。对于蓝军来说，这是一个在赛季初取得三场三胜的机会。我们最新的胜利发生在周四晚上，我们在卡拉宝杯第二轮比赛中击败了卢顿镇。阿隆索选择了一支实力强劲的球队，丹尼·维尔贝克的头球和哈基姆·奥多芬的乌龙球帮助我们晋级第三轮。科尔威尔和昆达都没有参与对抗帽匠队。然而阿隆索强调没有理由担心，两名球员都在忙碌的一周中接受管理。他解释说：“没有任何问题，计划是他们（从周五开始）训练并为周日的比赛做准备。 “对于列维来说，上赛季受伤后，他仍然处于必须采取正确步骤的时期，我们不想给他太大的压力。我们希望确保[他的身体]不会受到压力，并且他感觉舒适和健康。吉奥也是如此。凯塞多本赛季尚未为蓝军出场，因为在我们的首场比赛之前，阿隆索详细描述了在训练中遭受的挫折。然而，蓝军主帅希望厄瓜多尔人能够在他的前俱乐部来访之前进行训练，并在周日的比赛中入选。阿隆索说：“他希望能够（周五）进行训练，我们希望他能够参加（对阵布莱顿的比赛）。但我们需要检查一下。目前尚未做出任何决定。”韦斯利·福法纳（Wesley Fofana）预计将在周日重返蓝军，他在对阵卢顿的两场比赛中停赛第二场。与此同时，夏季签约的乔丹·亨德森可能需要更多时间，阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上确认，在世界杯期间受伤后，蓝军正在等待他“尽快上场”。

news.title: Analysis: How POTM Estevao provided Chelsea’s spark
news.title_zh: 分析：POTM Estevao 如何为切尔西带来火花
news.body_en: We take a detailed look at Estevao Willian’s role in Chelsea’s Carabao Cup victory over Luton Town after he was voted as our Player of the Match by the Blues supporters. The Blues booked our place in the third round of this season’s Carabao Cup – where we will take on old rivals Leeds United – by defeating Luton 2-0 at Stamford Bridge on Thursday evening. Estevao played a key role in our victory. The Brazil international had a hand in both our goals and earned 34 per cent of votes in our Player of the Match ballot on the Chelsea Official App. Here's why... Having come off the bench in our Premier League opener away at Fulham, Estevao was handed his chance to impress new manager Xabi Alonso from the start in our first home game of 2026/27. That came as Alonso shifted to a 4-2-3-1 shape for his starting line-up – and it is a system that suits the Brazilian winger well. Operating on the right, Estevao was able to drift inside onto his left foot. Along with Morgan Rogers doing the same on the opposite flank, the two wide men were able to link up with Cole Palmer and striker Danny Welbeck ahead of him to overload Luton’s defence in the centre of the pitch. Estevao’s movement from that right-wing also created space for the marauding Malo Gusto to use his pace to overlap into promising crossing positions and create chances. It was that which led to Chelsea’s opening goal shortly after half-time, when Estevao and Gusto combined well to give the Frenchman the chance to deliver a dangerous cross from wide, headed in by Welbeck to give the striker his first goal for the club. Chelsea dominated the ball against our League One opponents; clear from our 65.7 per cent share of possession on the night. It allowed us to take the game to Luton and play high up the pitch, giving Estevao ample opportunity to operate where he does best, causing problems deep into opposition territory. As always, the Brazilian’s ability when running with the ball was a big part of that. His five dribbles were the most of any player on the pitch and he successfully completed four of them, also the highest number of the game. He had the end product to make those dribbles count too, with his six crosses the most of any player and five chances created, the joint-best alongside Palmer. Palmer was also the only player to register more than Estevao’s four shots across the 90 minutes, and it was one of those by the latter which made our victory safe, when the Brazilian’s low drive was deflected in off Luton defender Hakeem Odoffin, officially being recorded as an own goal.
news.body_zh: 在埃斯特沃·威廉被蓝军支持者评选为本场比赛最佳球员后，我们详细了解了埃斯特沃·威廉在切尔西战胜卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛中所扮演的角色。周四晚上，蓝军在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败卢顿，锁定了本赛季卡拉宝杯第三轮的席位，我们将在那里迎战老对手利兹联。 Estevao 在我们的胜利中发挥了关键作用。这位巴西国脚参与了我们的两个进球，并在切尔西官方应用程序的本场最佳球员评选中获得了 34% 的选票。这就是为什么......在我们客场对阵富勒姆的英超揭幕战中替补出场后，埃斯特沃有机会在我们 2026/27 赛季的第一场主场比赛中从一开始就给新任主帅哈维·阿隆索留下深刻印象。与此同时，阿隆索的首发阵容转变为 4-2-3-1 阵型，而这个阵型非常适合这位巴西边锋。埃斯特沃在右路操作，他能够用左脚向内移动。随着摩根·罗杰斯在另一侧做同样的事情，这两名边路球员能够与科尔·帕尔默和前锋丹尼·维尔贝克联手，在球场中央压垮卢顿的防守。埃斯特瓦从右翼的跑动也为掠夺性的马洛·古斯托创造了空间，让他利用自己的速度重叠到有希望的传中位置并创造机会。正是这一点导致了切尔西在半场结束后不久就取得了首个进球，当时埃斯特沃和古斯托的出色配合为法国人提供了从边路送出危险传中的机会，维尔贝克的头球破门为前锋打进了他为俱乐部的第一个进球。切尔西在对阵我们甲级联赛的对手时占据了控球权；当晚我们的控球率为 65.7%。这让我们能够把比赛带到卢顿，并在前场打球，让埃斯特沃有足够的机会在他最擅长的地方发挥作用，在对手的领土深处制造问题。一如既往，巴西人带球跑动的能力是其中的重要组成部分。他的五次带球是场上所有球员中最多的，并且他成功完成了其中四次，也是全场最高的。他的最终表现也让这些运球发挥了作用，他的六次传中是所有球员中最多的，并创造了五次机会，与帕尔默并列最佳。帕尔默也是唯一一位在 90 分钟内射门次数超过埃斯特沃四次射门的球员，正是埃斯特沃的射门次数之一确保了我们的胜利，巴西人的低射被卢顿后卫哈基姆·奥多芬挡住，正式被记录为乌龙球。

news.title: Chelsea Football Club announces Circle Internet Group as Principal Partner
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部宣布 Circle Internet Group 成为主要合作伙伴
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club today announces a landmark partnership with Circle Internet Group, Inc, one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies. The new partnership sees Circle become a Principal Partner and our official front-of-shirt partner beginning with the 2026/27 season. The partnership comes at a pivotal moment for the world. Stablecoins are moving from early adoption toward the mainstream, creating an unprecedented opportunity to make money as open, accessible, and useful as the internet itself. By reducing the cost and friction of moving value, they can broaden participation in the global economy and unlock greater opportunity for people everywhere. Bringing USDC to one of sport’s biggest global stages reflects the scale and ambition of this opportunity. Founded in 2013, Circle is a pioneer in digital assets and is helping build the financial system for the internet. At its centre is USDC, the world’s leading regulated stablecoin. USDC is a trusted digital dollar that enables people and businesses to move money globally with internet speed and 24/7 availability. In the 2026/27 season, Circle and USDC brands will appear on the front of Chelsea's Men's, Women's and Academy shirts, featuring for the first time at Chelsea FC men’s first Premier League home game of the season this Sunday against Brighton. Jeremy Allaire, Co-Founder and CEO, Circle: 'We built USDC on the belief that money should work seamlessly for everyone everywhere, the way the internet does. Partnering with Chelsea connects us with a global sports community built on that exact same borderless vision. Kash Razzaghi, Chief Commercial Officer, Circle: 'This partnership represents a shared belief in where the world is headed. Chelsea connects hundreds of millions of people across every border, and USDC is digital money that moves across those same borders. USDC on the iconic Chelsea shirt shows the world what the future of global finance looks like: open, borderless, and built for everyone. Jason Gannon, President, Chelsea FC: 'This partnership with Circle positions Chelsea at the forefront of football’s digital evolution. We are two organisations fixated by the future and are relentlessly innovating to be in the best position possible for the long-term. We look forward to beginning our journey with Circle – to introduce Circle to the Chelsea family and continue enhancing how we operate' Aki Mandhar, CEO, Chelsea FC Women: ‘We are excited to introduce Circle and USDC to the Chelsea Women family for our inaugural season at Stamford Bridge. Forging and facilitating connections between people is what Chelsea Women and Circle do best and we look forward to bringing USDC to the CFCW fanbase and beyond.’ Todd Kline, President of Commercial, Chelsea FC: ‘Circle is changing how money moves around the world, and we’re changing what it means to be a global football club. That’s real alignment, not just in values but in our shared ambition to lead on a global stage. This is more than a logo on a shirt, it represents a partner who’s building something. We’re excited to see what we can build together.’ Don't miss out! Click here to register your interest and be the first to know when our newly branded 2026/27 home and away shirts go on sale!

news.title: Inside the life of Melvine Malard
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德的生活内部
news.body_en: After scoring a brace on her Chelsea debut against Real Sociedad, Melvine Malard fills us in on her footballing journey so far and how she likes to spend her time away from the sport. Can you tell us where you grew up and what it was like there? The name of the place is Ile de la Reunion. I played football over there. All my family is there. When I was 14 years old, I came to play football in a big club at Lyon. That's my life, and everything started from there. It’s very sunny there. Never cold. There are beaches, and there’s good food. You know, very, very colourful. What age did you start playing football? I started very late. About six or seven. At first, I didn’t really know that I would enjoy playing football. I played all sports, like boxing and handball with my sister. She was very good, and we played together. Afterwards, I tried football with the men because at that time it was only boys. I felt very confident in football, and then I said: 'That's going to be my job.' What was the name of your first grassroots team? The name was Saint-Denis FC. It’s the capital of La Reunion. Everything was with the boys over there. At first I didn’t play striker; I was a central defender. Then I moved forward to midfield and now striker, so it feels good to score in front of the people and in the big stadiums. Which person has influenced you the most in your career? I’m one of these people when you're born somewhere very far and are not rich. A godmother is someone who gives you the motivation to go forward in your life. So, I can say my godmother because in my family I don't have anyone who plays football, but she wanted me to follow my dreams. What's been the best moment of your career so far? I would like to say when you win something you work really hard for, like a trophy. Winning the Champions League was a really good memory for me. Of course, I have four Champions Leagues, but I only really played and started in two of them so I feel very proud of myself for those. I played some of those games in front of my family so you know, that’s the best part. Who are your best friends in football? My ball... (laughs). I actually don't have a very best friend, but it's true that in Manchester, I had some good friends over there, like Jade Riviere. She helped me a lot with everything, on and off the pitch. Manchester is a very good city, with very good people, and a very good atmosphere. Can you tell me your top three favourite footballers ever? I love Marta. Dzsenifer Marozsan. And Ronaldinho. He is a player, you know, where you watch, and you see he is not thinking; he is just playing and enjoying, and I love that. He did what his body wanted to do, not his head and played without fear. What do you like to do away from football? I really love to enjoy time with my family; that’s the most important thing. Now I have a wife, and I enjoy spending time with her. I love fashion. So I spend a lot of money on that passion! I also enjoy taking care of my body because my job is football, and I know that is very important. So, you know, recovery, staying home, enjoying the moment and relaxing. Are you watching any TV series at the moment? Who is your favourite music artist on Spotify? Ooh, I really love Shenseea. Burna Boy, too. Everything Afrobeat, you know? What are your top three places to go on holiday? I want to say Mexico. I love it there. I got engaged there. Of course, La Reunion. And I think Spain is the best also. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them? I really love sweet potatoes. I’d do them with bacon. Can you tell the Chelsea fans something they might not know about you? When you see me, you can see I love football, and I enjoy it when I play. I’m not thinking a lot when I'm on the pitch. So I want you to enjoy it with me! What's the best piece of advice you've ever received? Seriously, it's just like, don't forget where you were born. Where you come from. What does football mean to you? Football means everything. You know, I said to my sister this morning, if Melvine don't have football, it's not Melvine. Football gave me a reason to do well, mentally and physically.
news.body_zh: 在对阵皇家社会队的切尔西首秀中梅开二度后，梅尔文·马拉德向我们讲述了她迄今为止的足球之旅，以及她如何度过远离足球的时光。您能告诉我们您在哪里长大以及那里的情况如何吗？这个地方的名字是留尼汪岛。我在那里踢足球。我所有的家人都在那里。当我14岁的时候，我来到里昂的一家大俱乐部踢球。这就是我的生活，一切都从那里开始。那里阳光明媚。从来不冷。这里有海滩，还有美食。你知道，非常非常丰富多彩。您几岁开始踢足球？我开始得很晚。大约有六、七个人。起初，我并不知道自己会喜欢踢足球。我和姐姐一起参加所有运动，比如拳击和手球。她人很好，我们一起玩。后来我尝试和男人一起踢足球，因为当时只有男孩。我对足球非常有信心，然后我说：“这将是我的工作。”你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？这个名字是圣丹尼斯足球俱乐部。它是留尼汪岛的首府。一切都和那边的男孩们在一起。起初我并不踢前锋，而是踢前锋。我是一名中后卫。然后我升到了中场，现在是前锋，所以在人们面前和在大体育场里进球的感觉很好。在您的职业生涯中，哪个人对您影响最大？当你出生在很远的地方并且并不富有时，我就是其中之一。教母是给你生活前进动力的人。所以，我可以说我的教母，因为我家里没有人踢足球，但她希望我追随我的梦想。到目前为止，你职业生涯中最好的时刻是什么？我想说的是，当你赢得一些你真正努力争取的东西时，比如奖杯。赢得冠军联赛对我来说是一个非常美好的回忆。当然，我有四次欧冠冠军，但我只真正踢过并首发过其中两次，所以我为自己感到非常自豪。我在家人面前玩了其中一些游戏，所以你知道，这是最好的部分。谁是你足球界最好的朋友？我的球……（笑）。事实上我没有一个最好的朋友，但在曼彻斯特，我确实有一些好朋友，比如杰德·里维埃。她在场上场下的所有事情上都给了我很多帮助。曼彻斯特是一个非常好的城市，有非常好的人民，而且气氛非常好。你能告诉我你最喜欢的前三名足球运动员吗？我爱玛尔塔。杰塞尼弗·马洛桑。还有罗纳尔迪尼奥。他是一名球员，你知道，你在哪里观看，你都会发现他没有思考；他没有思考。他只是在玩耍和享受，我喜欢这一点。他做的是他的身体想做的事，而不是他的头脑，并且毫无恐惧地打球。足球之外你喜欢做什么？我真的很喜欢和家人一起享受时光；这是最重要的事情。现在我有妻子了，我很享受和她在一起的时光。我喜欢时尚。所以我在这种热情上花了很多钱！我也喜欢照顾自己的身体，因为我的工作是足球，我知道这非常重要。所以，你知道，康复、呆在家里、享受当下、放松。你现在在看什么电视剧吗？ Spotify 上您最喜欢的音乐艺术家是谁？哦，我真的很喜欢Shenseea。伯纳男孩也是。一切都是非洲节奏，你知道吗？你最想去的三个度假胜地是哪三个？我想说墨西哥。我喜欢那里。我在那里订婚了。当然是留尼汪岛。我认为西班牙也是最好的。如果你有客人来吃饭，你会为他们做什么菜？我真的很喜欢红薯。我会用培根来做。你能告诉切尔西球迷一些他们可能不知道的关于你的事情吗？当你看到我时，你会发现我热爱足球，并且当我踢球时我很享受。当我在球场上时，我不会想太多。所以我希望你和我一起享受它！您收到过的最好的建议是什么？说真的，就像，不要忘记你出生在哪里。你来自哪里。足球对你来说意味着什么？足球意味着一切。你知道，今天早上我对我姐姐说，如果梅尔文没有足球，那就不是梅尔文。足球给了我在精神上和身体上都表现出色的理由。

news.title: Alonso on a 'special day' for Blues debutants and why Palmer played 90
news.title_zh: 阿隆索在蓝军首次亮相的“特殊日子”以及为什么帕尔默打了90场比赛
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes our Carabao Cup victory over Luton Town was a ‘special day’ that Blues debutants Valentin Barco, Mike Penders and Danny Welbeck will long remember. Having not featured in our opening fixture of the season away to Fulham on Monday night, the trio were named in the Chelsea starting XI by Alonso for our first outing of the campaign at Stamford Bridge. All made their mark on the contest. Welbeck scored our opener against the Hatters with a well-taken header from a Malo Gusto cross. Barco was involved in our second goal of the night, winning the ball in midfield before finding Cole Palmer, who put Estevao Willian in a position to force an own goal from Hakeem Odoffin At the opposite end, Penders wasn’t unduly tested by Luton but ended his Chelsea debut with a deserved clean sheet. Alonso was pleased for each of the trio, as well as those who were making their full debuts or first competitive outings at Stamford Bridge. He said: 'For them it's a special day that they will remember. Mike will be happy because for a goalkeeper, to make his debut and keep a clean sheet feels good. Valentin had an impressive performance: very dynamic, good with the ball, very aware of what was going on in the midfield. ‘Danny was the patient player. He was the one who had to be in the box waiting for one good cross to come. In the first half we were close but we couldn’t get it. ‘Then he scored the first goal, which was important. A great cross from Malo and he did what he does best: to be in the right place and score.’ Our debuting trio were part of a strong side named by Alonso. Among the starters was Cole Palmer, who completed 90 minutes and ended the game with the captain’s armband after Reece James was brought off in the second period. Alonso was asked after the game why he felt Palmer was ready to start and finish the contest against the Hatters. He replied: 'Cole has had a great pre-season and is well prepared, so he’s one of the players who can take the 90 minutes. 'We had an idea, depending on the context of the game, but Cole has a very good fitness level in terms of his stamina and now he needs to recover well on Sunday.'
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索相信我们在联赛杯中战胜卢顿镇的比赛是一个“特殊的日子”，蓝军新秀瓦伦丁·巴科、迈克·彭德斯和丹尼·维尔贝克将永远铭记在心。由于周一晚上我们客场对阵富勒姆的赛季首场比赛没有出场，这三人被阿隆索提名为切尔西首发阵容，这是我们本赛季在斯坦福桥的首次亮相。所有人都在比赛中留下了自己的印记。维尔贝克接到马洛·古斯托的传中，头球攻门，为我们对阵帽子队的比赛首开纪录。巴科参与了我们当晚的第二个进球，他在中场赢得了球权，然后找到科尔·帕尔默，科尔·帕尔默让埃斯特沃·威廉迫使哈基姆·奥多芬打进乌龙球。相反，潘德斯并没有受到卢顿的过度考验，但以一场当之无愧的不失球结束了他的切尔西首秀。阿隆索对三人组中的每一个以及那些在斯坦福桥首次亮相或首次参加比赛的人感到高兴。他说：“对他们来说，这是一个他们会记住的特殊日子。迈克会很高兴，因为对于一名门将来说，首次亮相并保持不失球感觉很好。瓦伦丁的表现令人印象深刻：非常有活力，控球能力出色，非常了解中场的情况。 “丹尼是一位很有耐心的球员。他是那个必须待在禁区里等待一个好传中的人。上半场我们很接近，但我们没能取得进球。 “然后他打进了第一个进球，这很重要。马洛的一次精彩传中，他做了他最擅长的事情：在正确的位置得分。”我们的首秀三人组是阿隆索命名的强大球队的一部分。科尔·帕尔默是首发球员之一，他打满了90分钟，并在第二节里斯·詹姆斯被换下后戴上队长袖标结束了比赛。赛后阿隆索被问及为什么他认为帕尔默已经准备好开始和结束与帽子队的比赛。他回答道：“科尔在季前赛中表现出色，并且做好了充分的准备，所以他是能够打满90分钟的球员之一。 “我们有一个想法，具体取决于比赛的情况，但科尔的体能水平非常好，现在他需要在周日恢复良好。”

news.title: From the archive: Azpilicueta's ingenuity helps Chelsea complete the set
news.title_zh: 来自档案：阿斯皮利奎塔的聪明才智帮助切尔西完成了比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea legend Cesar Azpilicueta turns 37 today, and to celebrate our former skipper's birthday, we tell the story of the vital role he played when we first won it all. Azpilicueta served Chelsea with distinction between 2012 and 2023, and in his penultimate season at the club, became the first player in our history to win every major trophy possible The last piece of silverware required was what was then known as the Club World Cup, and has since been rebranded as the Intercontinental Cup following the expansion of the tournament we won this summer. In February 2022, we beat Al Hilal in the semi-final, setting up a showdown with Brazilian side Palmeiras. It was there, in the heat of Abu Dhabi, that our skipper's ingenuity helped ensure we returned home with a new piece of silverware in tow. It looked like the final was heading to penalties, but a shot from the Spaniard was blocked by a hand. VAR came into play, not for the first time at the Mohammed Zayed Stadium, and a spot-kick was awarded to the Blues. Azpilicueta immediately gathered the ball, and it very much looked like he was going to take the penalty in the absence of Jorginho, our regular taker. ‘It was a tactic because I knew how they are, I knew they were coming for the penalty taker, so I took the ball,’ said Azpilicueta, clearly a step ahead of everyone else in the stadium. ‘Kai [Havertz] knew that he was going to shoot, so it was to release the pressure from him. It was a decisive moment, and Kai is one of the best penalty takers. ‘I waited and listened to everything their players told me, and I think it worked, which is the most important thing.’ How it worked! Havertz coolly converted from 12 yards, and we saw out the closing stages with the minimum of fuss to secure our second trophy of that campaign, and the ninth of Azpilicueta's Blues career. For our dependable Spaniard, it marked a completion of the set, and redemption for defeat to Corinthians nearly a decade prior. ‘I’m really proud of it,’ the skipper beamed after the game. ‘We have come a long way to be here. It’s a moment to be proud and enjoy it because we know how difficult it is to win this trophy. 2012 hurt a lot and we took more than nine years to be back. We missed out in 2012 and we didn’t want to miss the cup again. ‘This time the medal is gold, and the other one is silver. I made sure I wasn’t coming back with the same colour of medal. It was a difficult game. World champions, it’s not easy. We showed the team we are. ‘When I arrived in 2012, I couldn’t imagine the journey I would go on,’ added Azpi. ‘I’m really proud to be the Chelsea captain leading the club on and off the pitch. This title feels very good because it’s the first time in our history. I’m so proud we achieved it.’ After joining Chelsea from Marseille in the summer of 2012 as a full-back little known on these shores, Azpilicueta went on to win the Premier League twice, the Champions League, the Europa League twice, the FA Cup, the League Cup, the Super Cup and, after two hours of tense football in the UAE, the Club World Cup. No Chelsea player can lay claim to such a varied honours' board. His place in the pantheon of Blues greats is secured.
news.body_zh: 切尔西传奇人物塞萨尔·阿兹皮利奎塔今天满 37 岁了，为了庆祝我们的前队长的生日，我们讲述他在我们首次赢得胜利时所扮演的重要角色的故事。阿斯皮利奎塔在 2012 年至 2023 年期间为切尔西效力，并在他在俱乐部的倒数第二个赛季中成为我们历史上第一位赢得所有重要奖杯的球员。所需的最后一块奖杯是当时被称为俱乐部世界杯的奖杯，随着我们今年夏天赢得的赛事扩大，该奖杯已更名为洲际杯。 2022年2月，我们在半决赛中击败了阿尔希拉尔队，与巴西球队帕尔梅拉斯队展开对决。正是在那里，在阿布扎比的炎热天气里，我们船长的聪明才智帮助我们带着一件新的银器回家了。看起来决赛即将进入点球大战，但西班牙人的射门被一只手挡出。 VAR在穆罕默德·扎耶德体育场并不是第一次发挥作用，蓝军获得了点球。阿斯皮利奎塔立即接住了球，在我们的主罚球员若日尼奥缺席的情况下，看起来他将主罚点球。 “这是一种战术，因为我知道他们的情况，我知道他们是冲着主罚点球的，所以我接了球，”阿斯皮利奎塔说道，他显然比体育场内的其他人领先一步。 “凯（哈弗茨）知道他要投篮，所以这是为了释放他的压力。这是一个决定性的时刻，凯是最好的点球主罚者之一。 “我等待并听取了他们的球员告诉我的一切，我认为它有效，这是最重要的事情。”它是如何运作的！哈弗茨在 12 码处冷静地完成射门，我们以最少的麻烦完成了最后阶段，确保了我们该赛季的第二座奖杯，也是阿斯皮利奎塔蓝军生涯的第九座奖杯。对于我们可靠的西班牙人来说，这标志着这盘比赛的结束，也标志着近十年前输给科林蒂安队的救赎。 “我真的为此感到自豪，”队长在赛后微笑着说道。 ‘我们走了很长的路才来到这里。这是一个值得自豪和享受的时刻，因为我们知道赢得这座奖杯是多么困难。 2012 年我们经历了很多痛苦，我们花了九年多的时间才回来。我们错过了2012年的奖杯，我们不想再次错过奖杯。 “这次奖牌是金牌，另一枚是银牌。我确保我不会带着同样颜色的奖牌回来。这是一场艰难的比赛。世界冠军，不容易。我们向球队展示了我们的实力。 “当我 2012 年抵达时，我无法想象我会继续什么样的旅程，”阿斯皮补充道。 “我真的很自豪能够成为切尔西队长，在球场内外领导俱乐部。这个标题感觉非常好，因为这是我们历史上的第一次。我很自豪我们实现了这一目标。”2012 年夏天，阿斯皮利奎塔作为一名在当地鲜为人知的边后卫从马赛加盟切尔西，随后两次赢得英超联赛冠军、欧冠冠军、两次欧罗巴联赛冠军、足总杯冠军、联赛杯冠军、超级杯冠军，并在阿联酋经过两个小时的紧张足球比赛后，赢得了世俱杯冠军。没有任何切尔西球员能够拥有如此多样化的荣誉委员会。他在蓝调伟人万神殿中的地位已经稳固。

news.title: Welbeck: 'It's such a privilege to play with these players'
news.title_zh: 维尔贝克：“能和这些球员一起踢球真是一种荣幸”
news.body_en: Danny Welbeck has described playing with his Chelsea team-mates as ‘such a privilege’ and believes the Blues can achieve ‘something special’ over the coming years. Welbeck marked his Chelsea debut against Luton with a goal as the Blues reached the third round of the League Cup courtesy of our 2-0 victory at Stamford Bridge. The 35-year-old’s career has seen him represent England 42 times, win the title at Manchester United and lift the FA Cup twice during his time at Arsenal. He has played with some of the Premier League’s greatest ever players over the years but still appreciates being able to share a pitch with the likes of Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Estevao Willian. 'It's such a privilege to play with some of these players and it's a joy when you're out there on the pitch,’ he said. ‘For me, playing as a nine today, it was more about staying on the last line. When the ball came into me, I was always ready to link up with the likes of Morgan and Cole. I really enjoyed that and I'm looking forward to it happening a lot more.' This summer has seen the Blues sign experienced players like Welbeck, Jordan Henderson and Maxence Lacroix, while continuing to add exciting talents such as Valentin Barco, Geovany Quenda and Marco Palestra to our squad. With world-class operators like Moises Caicedo, Reece James and Palmer already among our ranks, plus the addition of a title-winning manager in Xabi Alonso, Welbeck believes the Blues could have a season to remember. 'We can build something special here,’ he said. 'With the quality of players we have here, it's only right that we believe we can achieve something special. We'll keep pushing and working every single day, and we'll be trying to get those results at the weekends.' Welbeck signed for the Blues on August 1 from Brighton and Hove Albion, and started two games during our pre-season tour, before injury ruled him out of our season opener against Fulham on Monday night. He returned on Thursday night to make his competitive debut and had an immediate impact, linking up well with the likes of Estevao, Palmer and Rogers as the Blues laid siege to Luton’s goal. It was the striker who finally broke the deadlock early in the second half when he headed in Malo Gusto’s superb first-time cross. Welbeck said: 'It's really nice to get a goal on your debut and to get off the mark right from the start. So I am really pleased with that. 'More importantly, I'm pleased to get through to the next round and we've got to stand strong in every single competition this season.' The Blues had 26 shots on the night but had to remain patient as they searched for the opener, with Welbeck concluding: 'I think patience was really important. It's never easy against a low block, so you have to keep circulating the ball, moving it from side to side and looking for openings. 'In the first half, there were a few opportunities where we could maybe have got the first goal, but it didn't quite come. At half-time, the message was to get the ball into the box a bit earlier and put some crosses in. 'It was a good message and it worked well. Malo put in a quality delivery and I was there to nod it in.' Blues fans will be hoping this was the first of many for Danny this season.
news.body_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克形容与切尔西队友一起踢球是“一种荣幸”，并相信蓝军可以在未来几年取得“一些特别的成就”。维尔贝克在切尔西对阵卢顿的比赛中攻入一球，帮助蓝军在斯坦福桥2-0获胜，晋级联赛杯第三轮。这位35岁的球员在职业生涯中代表英格兰出场42次，在曼联夺得冠军，在阿森纳期间两次捧起足总杯冠军。多年来，他曾与一些英超历史上最伟大的球员一起踢球，但仍然很高兴能够与科尔·帕尔默、摩根·罗杰斯和埃斯特沃·威廉等人同场竞技。他说：“能够与其中一些球员一起踢球是一种荣幸，当你在球场上时，这也是一种快乐。” “对我来说，今天打九号位，更多的是留在最后一线。当球传到我身边时，我总是准备好与摩根和科尔这样的球员联手。我真的很喜欢这样，我期待更多这样的事情发生。今年夏天，蓝军签下了维尔贝克、乔丹·亨德森和马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦等经验丰富的球员，同时继续为我们的阵容增添瓦伦丁·巴科、乔瓦尼·昆达和马可·帕莱斯特拉等令人兴奋的天才球员。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多、里斯·詹姆斯和帕尔默等世界级教练已经在我们的队伍中，再加上哈维·阿隆索这位冠军教练的加入，维尔贝克相信蓝军将会有一个值得铭记的赛季。 “我们可以在这里建造一些特别的东西，”他说。 “凭借我们这里拥有的球员的素质，我们相信我们能够取得一些特别的成就，这是正确的。我们将继续每天努力工作，并努力在周末取得这些成果。”维尔贝克于8月1日从布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩加盟蓝军，并在我们的季前赛中首发了两场比赛，之后因伤缺席了周一晚上对阵富勒姆的赛季揭幕战。周四晚上，他复出，完成了他的正式比赛首秀，并立即产生了影响，在蓝军围攻卢顿球门时，他与埃斯特沃、帕尔默和罗杰斯等人配合默契。这位前锋在下半场一开始就在马洛·古斯托的首次传中头球破门，最终打破了僵局。维尔贝克表示：“在首秀中就取得进球并从一开始就取得进球真是太好了。所以我对此非常满意。 “更重要的是，我很高兴能够进入下一轮，我们必须在本赛季的每场比赛中保持坚强。”蓝军当晚有 26 次射门，但在寻找揭幕战时必须保持耐心，维尔贝克总结道：“我认为耐心非常重要。”对抗低位球员从来都不是一件容易的事，所以你必须不断地传球，从一边移动到另一边，寻找空档。 “上半场，我们有几次机会或许可以取得第一个进球，但最终没有实现。半场结束时，传达的信息是要早点将球送入禁区并进行一些传中。“这是一个很好的信息，而且效果很好。”马洛的交付质量很高，我也在那里点头同意。”蓝调球迷希望这是丹尼本赛季众多比赛中的第一个。

news.title: Xabi Alonso on conviction, patience and learning from Luton victory
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈信念、耐心并从卢顿胜利中学习
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso accepts Luton Town made it difficult for his Chelsea side to secure a place in the Carabao Cup third round, but feels the Blues gained valuable experience by breaking down a low block during tonight's 2-0 victory at Stamford Bridge. Alonso's side had to work hard during our first competitive home outing of the season. The Hatters sat deep and in a compact shape; it was not an easy evening. That was reflected in the fact that the game was goalless at half-time. However, five minutes into the second period, we broke the deadlock as a wonderful cross from Malo Gusto was headed home by Danny Welbeck on his Chelsea debut. Victory was secured as the game moved toward its conclusion. Estevao Willian played a key role in the goal, driving a shot toward the far corner that defender Hakeem Odoffin could only turn into his own net. Our win – and the manner of it - was vindication for the strength of the starting XI named by Alonso. He was not taking the Hatters lightly. 'We always want to choose a competitive team, he said. 'We are taking all the games seriously, and we are in a moment in the season where many things and processes are starting. 'I’m happy many players had their first minutes for the club, making their debut and playing their first competitive game in this stadium. It wasn’t easy - credit to Luton, as they made it difficult – but we played with conviction and patience, knowing the first goal was going to come in a moment, and Danny took it really well.' The post-match stats highlighted our dominance across the 90 minutes. We enjoyed 65 per cent possession, registered 26 shots, 45 touches in the opposition area and limited Luton to just one shot on target. It's why Alonso again described his side's display as 'serious' and emphasised how the game could prove beneficial for the Blues during the season ahead. 'For sure, it’s a performance to learn how to attack a low block. Against a 5-4-1, it’s not easy against any team from any league. We need to learn from today, as we will face this context in other games as well.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索承认卢顿镇让他的切尔西队很难获得卡拉宝杯第三轮的席位，但他认为蓝军在今晚2-0战胜斯坦福桥的比赛中突破低位防守获得了宝贵的经验。阿隆索的球队在本赛季第一次主场比赛中必须努力工作。帽匠们坐得很深，形状也很紧凑。这不是一个轻松的夜晚。这反映在半场比赛双方互交白卷的事实上。然而，第二节开始五分钟后，我们打破了僵局，马洛·古斯托的精彩传中被丹尼·维尔贝克头球破门，这是他在切尔西的处子秀。随着比赛接近尾声，胜利已经确定。埃斯特沃·威廉在进球中发挥了关键作用，他的一脚射门打向远角，后卫哈基姆·奥多芬只能将球打入自家球门。我们的胜利——以及胜利的方式——证明了阿隆索首发阵容的实力。他并没有掉以轻心。 “我们总是想选择一支有竞争力的球队，”他说。 “我们正在认真对待所有比赛，我们正处于本赛季许多事情和进程都开始的时刻。 “我很高兴许多球员在俱乐部度过了他们的第一分钟，完成了他们的处子秀，并在这个体育场打了他们的第一场正式比赛。这并不容易——感谢卢顿，因为他们让这一切变得困难——但我们以信念和耐心踢球，知道第一个进球很快就会到来，丹尼很好地接受了这一点。赛后统计数据凸显了我们在 90 分钟内的统治力。我们拥有 65% 的控球率，射门 26 次，在对方区域触球 45 次，并限制卢顿只有 1 次射正。这就是为什么阿隆索再次形容他的球队的表现是“认真的”，并强调这场比赛将如何在未来的赛季对蓝军有益。 “当然，这是学习如何攻击低位的表演。面对 5-4-1 阵型，无论是哪个联赛的球队，这都不是一件容易的事。我们需要从今天吸取教训，因为我们在其他游戏中也会面临这种情况。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 2-0 Luton Town
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 2-0 卢顿镇
news.body_en: Danny Welbeck's debut header and an own goal from Hakeem Odoffin ensured the Blues booked a place in the Carabao Cup third round after overcoming Luton Town 2-0 at Stamford Bridge. Xabi Alonso, overseeing a competitive game in the Stamford Bridge dugout for the first time, named a strong side and the Blues controlled the contest from start to finish. However, the game was goalless at the interval despite several chances being fashioned. The deadlock was broken early into the second period – and it was a well-constructed goal. Estevao Willian linked up with Malo Gusto down the right flank, before the France international produced an inch-perfect cross for Welbeck to head home. Estevao was a constant threat and, with 11 minutes remaining, the Brazilian forced our second as his low drive struck the unfortunate Odoffin on its route to goal. We could have had more goals – Cole Palmer was denied on several occasions and both Morgan Rogers and Jamie Gittens hit the woodwork – but importantly the Blues have advanced to set up a third-round tie with Leeds United. Alonso included three debutants in his starting XI: Mike Penders, Valentin Barco and Danny Welbeck. They came into a strong side that also included Malo Gusto, Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Pep Chavarria, Reece James, Estevao, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer. The game quickly settled into a pattern, with the Blues probing a resolute and deep Luton backline. Space was tight, but we carved our way through on multiple occasions. Palmer was first to threaten. The England international deftly exchanged passes with Estevao on the edge of the Luton area and whipped a shot toward goal. Josh Keeley saved and quickly reacted to deny Palmer on the rebound. From the resultant corner, Palmer dragged a shot wide. Gusto then fired a shot comfortably over the crossbar as we searched for the opener. Keeley was worked again midway through the half as, after Estevao had been fouled, James forced the Luton goalkeeper into a full-length save to keep out a free-kick. Our Brazilian winger then went close himself, driving a shot wide after a neat through pass from Barco. The visitors' threat was minimal during the opening 45 minutes; a header from Hakeem Odoffin that Penders easily saved was their best effort on goal. As the half moved toward its conclusion, we came inches away from breaking the deadlock. Estevao was once again involved as he broke beyond the Luton backline and cut a pass back to Rogers, who steered a volley against the crossbar. Rogers was involved in the construction of our next chance, showcasing neat footwork to evade two challenges and open up the pitch for Chavarria. The Spaniard played a pass to Palmer, but the striker's shot was blocked en route to goal. Come the half-time whistle, the Blues still had work to do. Alonso opted against any alterations at the interval – and the Blues boss was rewarded as his side opened the scoring five minutes into the second period. It was a well-crafted goal. The ball was worked to Estevao down the right flank, and the Brazil international stayed patient until the opportunity arrived to slip a pass through to the overlapping Gusto. He produced an excellent cross and Welbeck was perfectly positioned to head home. Luton attempted to rally, but they were largely kept at bay. The closest the visitors came to breaching Penders' goal were shots from distance from substitute Isaish Jones and Chelsea Academy graduate Kasey Palmer. Neither were on target, though. At the opposite end, Palmer's quest for a goal continued and our No.10 came inches away from finding the top corner with a powerful, curled attempt that flew just wide. Alonso turned to his bench with 23 minutes remaining; Jorrel Hato, Romeo Lavia and Pedro Neto were introduced for Gusto, James and Rogers. Joao Pedro replaced Joao Pedro soon after. The changes gave the Blues fresh impetus – and a second goal soon arrived to ensure our passage into the third round. Barco was instrumental, reclaiming possession in midfield and moving the ball to Palmer. He fed Estevao, who produced a quick stepover to shift the ball onto his right foot and drill a shot toward the far corner. His attempt struck Odoffin on its way to goal and ended the net. It proved Estevao's last involvement; he was replaced by Jamie Gittens before play restarted. The game was won, but there was time to add to the scoreline. Palmer continued to push for a goal and, as the game entered stoppage time, Keeley denied him once more and then stopped Joao Pedro's rebound. Gittens then went even closer, beating the Luton stopper but seeing his low drive strike the post. The third goal didn't arrive, but it didn't change the outcome. The Blues were through and, up next in the competition, come an old foe in Leeds United. The Blues go in search of our third victory in a week as we welcome Brighton and Hove Albion to Stamford Bridge on Sunday. The Premier League fixture kicks off at 2pm (UK time). news.body_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克的首个头球和哈基姆·奥多芬的乌龙球确保蓝军在斯坦福桥2-0战胜卢顿镇后获得卡拉宝杯第三轮的席位。哈维·阿隆索首次在斯坦福桥教练席观看一场激烈的比赛，他指定了一支强队，蓝军从头到尾控制了比赛。然而，尽管创造了几次机会，但比赛在中场休息时还是没有进球。僵局在第二节一开始就被打破了——这是一个精心设计的进球。埃斯特沃·威廉 (Estevao Willian) 在右翼与马洛·古斯托 (Malo Gusto) 连线，随后这位法国国脚为维尔贝克送出一记完美传中，头球破门。埃斯特沃持续构成威胁，在比赛还剩 11 分钟时，巴西人的低射击中了不幸的奥多芬，迫使我们获得第二球。我们本可以取得更多进球——科尔·帕尔默多次被挡出，摩根·罗杰斯和杰米·吉滕斯都击中门框——但重要的是，蓝军已经晋级，与利兹联队在第三轮打平。阿隆索的首发阵容中包括了三名首次亮相的球员：迈克·彭德斯、瓦伦丁·巴科和丹尼·维尔贝克。他们的阵容强大，还包括马洛·古斯托、乔什·阿奇姆蓬、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦、佩普·查瓦里亚、里斯·詹姆斯、埃斯特沃、摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默。比赛很快就进入了一个模式，蓝军不断探索卢顿坚定而纵深的后防线。空间很紧张，但我们多次开辟了道路。帕尔默首先发出威胁。这位英格兰国脚在卢顿禁区边缘巧妙地与埃斯特沃交换传球，然后将球射向球门。乔什·基利（Josh Keeley）扑救并迅速做出反应，挡住了帕尔默的篮板球。从最终的角球中，帕尔默的一脚射门偏出。当我们寻找开门红时，古斯托轻松地射门越过横梁。上半场中段，基利再次陷入困境，埃斯特沃被犯规后，詹姆斯迫使卢顿门将做出全长扑救，将任意球挡出。然后我们的巴西边锋自己近距离射门，在巴科巧妙的直传后射门偏出。客队在开场 45 分钟内的威胁微乎其微；奥多芬的头球被彭德斯轻松扑出，这是他们进球的最佳表现。当上半场即将结束时，我们距离打破僵局只有几英寸的距离。埃斯特瓦再次突破卢顿后防线，将球传回给罗杰斯，罗杰斯抽射击中横梁。罗杰斯参与了我们下一次机会的构建，展示了干净的脚步，避开了两次挑战，并为查瓦里亚打开了球场。西班牙人将球传给帕尔默，但前锋的射门在射门途中被挡出。半场哨声响起，蓝军仍有工作要做。阿隆索选择在中场休息时不做出任何改变——蓝军主帅得到了回报，他的球队在第二节比赛开始五分钟后就首开纪录。这是一个精心设计的目标。球传到了右翼的埃斯特瓦奥，这位巴西国脚保持着耐心，直到有机会将球传给重叠的古斯托。他送出一记出色的传中，维尔贝克完美地完成了回家的准备。卢顿试图重整旗鼓，但他们基本上被困住了。客队最接近突破彭德斯球门的是替补出场的伊赛什·琼斯和切尔西学院毕业生凯西·帕尔默的远距离射门。不过，两者都没有达到目标。在另一端，帕尔默继续寻求进球，我们的 10 号球员凭借一记强有力的弧线射门，距离球门上角只有几英寸，但稍稍偏出。比赛还剩 23 分钟时，阿隆索回到了替补席上。为古斯托、詹姆斯和罗杰斯介绍了乔雷尔·哈托、罗密欧·拉维亚和佩德罗·内托。若昂·佩德罗很快就替换了若昂·佩德罗。这些变化给蓝军带来了新的动力——第二个进球很快就到来，确保我们进入第三轮。巴科发挥了重要作用，在中场夺回了控球权，并将球传给了帕尔默。他传球给埃斯特沃，后者快速跨步将球转移到右脚，然后向远角射门。他的射门在奥多芬射门的途中击中了球门。这证明了埃斯特瓦最后一次参与；在比赛重新开始之前，他被杰米·吉滕斯替换。比赛赢了，但还有时间扩大比分。 帕尔默继续射门，比赛进入伤停补时阶段，基利再次挡出他的射门，并阻止了若昂·佩德罗的篮板球。吉滕斯随后距离更近，击败了卢顿队的门将，但他的低射击中了门柱。第三个进球没有到来，但这并没有改变结果。蓝军出线，下一个对手是老对手利兹联。蓝军将在周日欢迎布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩前往斯坦福桥，寻求一周内的第三场胜利。英超联赛将于下午 2 点（英国时间）开始。切尔西：彭德斯：古斯托（Hato 67）、阿奇姆蓬、拉克鲁瓦、查瓦里亚；詹姆斯 (c) (拉维亚 67)，巴可； Estevao（吉滕斯 80）、帕尔默、罗杰斯（内托 67）；维尔贝克（若昂·佩德罗 73）切尔西替补：桑切斯、安塞尔米诺、沃森、埃梅加进球球员：维尔贝克 50、奥多芬 79 卢顿镇：基利、阿什比、奥多芬、约翰斯顿、约翰逊、贝纳格尔、沃尔什、帕尔默、劳伦斯（福克斯 61）、科杜阿（理查兹 46）、马歇尔卢顿镇替补：谢伊、奈史密斯、安德森、威尔斯、琼斯、奇戈兹勒、科尔 黄牌：约翰逊 56

news.title: Xabi Alonso on Blues debutants and a serious approach
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈蓝军新秀和严肃的态度
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says his Chelsea side for tonight’s Carabao Cup second-round tie against Luton Town, which includes three debutants, indicates how seriously the Blues are taking the competition. Our first outing in this season's competition comes at Stamford Bridge, as we welcome the Hatters to west London. Alonso has made five changes to the side that defeated Fulham on Monday evening, but the likes of Maxence Lacroix, Reece James, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers have all been named in the starting XI. 'We want to have a good start in the Carabao Cup after the Premier League,' explained the Blues boss. 'For sure, playing at home, it needs to feel good and hopefully it will be a good start here this season. 'We want to take all the competitions seriously – for sure, this season all of them are a target. For each game, we choose the best competitive team we think and this one is good enough to go through.' Penders, who was part of our squad at last summer's Club World Cup before spending the 2025/26 campaign on loan at Strasbourg, is handed his maiden outing for the Blues. And Alonso has enjoyed working with the 21-year-old Belgian so far. He said: 'We want that he enjoys [himself], that he has composure and maturity, that he gets used to playing in a new stadium with new team-mates. 'So far, he is very mature for his age – it was great that he played very competitive football last year in Strasbourg. Now this is the next step, and we need to help him.'
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索表示，他的切尔西队将在今晚对阵卢顿镇的联赛杯第二轮比赛中出场，其中包括三名首次亮相的球员，这表明蓝军对这场比赛的重视程度。我们本赛季比赛的第一场比赛将在斯坦福桥举行，我们将欢迎帽匠队来到伦敦西部。阿隆索对周一晚上击败富勒姆的球队进行了五次调整，但马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦、里斯·詹姆斯、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯等人都被列入首发阵容。 “我们希望在英超联赛之后的卡拉宝杯中有一个良好的开局，”蓝军主帅解释道。 “当然，在主场比赛，需要感觉良好，希望本赛季能有一个好的开始。 “我们希望认真对待所有比赛——当然，本赛季所有比赛都是我们的目标。对于每场比赛，我们都会选择我们认为最具竞争力的球队，而这支球队足以晋级。彭德斯曾是我们球队的一员，参加了去年夏天的世俱杯，随后在 2025/26 赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡，这是他为蓝军首次出场。到目前为止，阿隆索很享受与这位 21 岁的比利时人一起工作。他说：“我们希望他享受（自己），冷静和成熟，习惯在新球场和新队友一起踢球。 “到目前为止，他对于他的年龄来说已经非常成熟了——去年他在斯特拉斯堡踢出了非常有竞争力的足球，这真是太棒了。现在这是下一步，我们需要帮助他。”

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has handed Chelsea debuts to Mike Penders, Valentin Barco and Danny Welbeck as the Blues take on Luton Town in the Carabao Cup second round. After overcoming Fulham in our season opener on Monday night, Alonso and his players' focus has turned to cup action in what is our first home game of the season. Penders is handed a first outing for the Blues and is expected to be protected by a back four of Malo Gusto, Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix and Pep Chavarria. Reece James is set to continue in midfield and captain the side alongside another debutant in Argentina international Barco. After scoring at Craven Cottage, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers remain in the attack and will be deployed alongside Estevao and Danny Welbeck, who makes his first appearance for the Blues since joining the club in the summer from Brighton and Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索将切尔西首秀交给了迈克·彭德斯、瓦伦丁·巴尔科和丹尼·维尔贝克，蓝军将在卡拉宝杯第二轮对阵卢顿镇。在周一晚上的赛季揭幕战中击败富勒姆后，阿隆索和他的球员们的注意力转向了杯赛，这是我们本赛季的第一场主场比赛。彭德斯将首次代表蓝军出战，预计将得到马洛·古斯托、乔什·阿奇姆蓬、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和佩普·查瓦里亚四后卫的保护。里斯·詹姆斯将继续担任中场球员并担任队长，与另一位首次亮相的阿根廷国脚巴科一起担任球队队长。在克雷文小屋进球后，科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯仍留在进攻中，并将与埃斯特沃和丹尼·维尔贝克一起部署，后者是自今年夏天从布莱顿和霍夫·阿尔比恩加盟俱乐部以来首次为蓝军出场。切尔西：彭德斯：古斯托、阿奇姆蓬、拉克鲁瓦、查瓦里亚；詹姆斯 (c)，巴可；埃斯特沃、帕尔默、罗杰斯；维尔贝克 切尔西替补：桑切斯、安塞尔米诺、哈托、沃森、拉维亚、吉滕斯、内托、埃梅加、若昂·佩德罗
